themes_detail.label: Street Infrastructure Collapse
themes_detail.summary: Street conditions complaints spiked to 34 THIS WEEK, a 533% increase from the 5.4-per-week baseline over the prior 8 weeks (z-score: 11.95), suggesting rapid deterioration of road surfaces across Crown Heights/Prospect Heights that may pose safety hazards to residents and vehicles.
evidence: 34 street condition complaints THIS WEEK vs. 5.4 weekly average (8-week baseline)
533% spike with z-score of 11.95 (extreme statistical anomaly)
Concurrent spike in street sign complaints (5 THIS WEEK vs. 0.4 avg, +1233%)
Related spike in damaged tree complaints (11 LAST WEEK vs. 1.1 avg, +878%)
reporting_angles: What triggered the sudden street deterioration—weather, deferred maintenance, or increased heavy vehicle traffic?
Map the geographic clusters of complaints to identify worst-hit blocks and interview affected residents

themes_detail.label: Street Noise Surge
themes_detail.summary: Noise complaints from streets and sidewalks jumped to 47 THIS WEEK, a 376% spike from the 9.9-per-week baseline (z-score: 9.63), indicating a sharp escalation in loud activity or street-level disturbances affecting neighborhood quality of life.
evidence: 47 street/sidewalk noise complaints THIS WEEK vs. 9.9 weekly average (8-week baseline)
376% spike with z-score of 9.63 (extreme statistical anomaly)
Concurrent rise in general complaints (43 LAST WEEK vs. 17.1 avg, +151%)
Noise remains elevated category despite overall heat/hot water dominating complaint volume
reporting_angles: Is this construction-related, nightlife-related, or linked to street vending/commercial activity?
Interview residents on specific blocks with highest noise complaints to identify sources and timing patterns

themes_detail.label: Neighborhood Cleanliness Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Dirty condition complaints surged to 47 THIS WEEK, a 208% increase from the 15.2-per-week baseline (z-score: 6.67), while litter basket complaints from 3 weeks ago marked a 3100% spike, reflecting both acute sanitation problems and persistent infrastructure gaps that align with community board's repeated 'other cleaning requests.'
evidence: 47 dirty condition complaints THIS WEEK vs. 15.2 weekly average (8-week baseline), +208%
Litter basket complaints peaked at 4 complaints 3 weeks ago vs. 0.1 weekly average (3100% spike, z-score: 11.72)
Community board has filed repeated 'other cleaning requests' annually to Department of Sanitation, indicating chronic issue
Unsanitary condition remains in top 6 overall complaint categories (636 complaints over 90 days)
reporting_angles: Are litter baskets overwhelmed, broken, or removed due to budget constraints? Interview DSNY about maintenance and deployment
Investigate whether street cleaning schedules have been reduced or if commercial/residential contributions to litter have increased

themes_detail.label: Tree Canopy Damage Spike
themes_detail.summary: Damaged tree complaints jumped to 11 LAST WEEK, an 878% increase from the 1.1-per-week baseline (z-score: 8.47), suggesting either weather-related trauma, storm damage, or accelerated urban tree decline in the district.
evidence: 11 damaged tree complaints LAST WEEK vs. 1.1 weekly average (8-week baseline), +878%
Z-score of 8.47 (extreme statistical anomaly)
Concurrent spike in street condition complaints suggests possible weather event or construction impact
Parks department budget requests include 'reconstruct or upgrade a building in a park,' indicating existing park maintenance gaps
reporting_angles: Was there a severe weather event or wind storm in the past week that damaged tree canopy?
Interview Parks Department about remediation timeline and whether tree maintenance budget is adequate for reactive repairs

themes_detail.label: Construction Site Safety Concerns
themes_detail.summary: BEST/Site Safety complaints spiked to 3 complaints 3 WEEKS AGO from a baseline of 0.2 per week (1100% spike, z-score: 6.35), coinciding with 438 total DOB permit filings in the district (287 alterations, 76 new buildings), suggesting inadequate site safety oversight amid active development.

Interview DOB about inspection frequency and enforcement action on active demolition and alteration sites
